goal: Extend the existing in-memory Skill catalog/version path with usage summaries and filters.

preservedInvariants: No parallel Skill Registry, taxonomy or lifecycle state machine
Catalog and exact-version results are immutable snapshots
No persistence, API, Console, Provider, Workflow or Runtime graph wiring
Legacy persisted candidate snapshots remain readable

testsActuallyRun.command: vitest run skill-registry and skill-selection unit tests

knownLimitations: Classification is derived from exact capabilities; no independent taxonomy is stored.
PostgreSQL and import audit persistence are Phase 7.
Management API, Console and Runtime graph wiring are intentionally absent.
